existing_fixes_note: No Melbourne or Victoria destination or spot exists in src/data yet (grep of destinations.ts and spots.ts for Australia/Melbourne found none), so nothing to move or merge. Internal fixes made here: Hosier Lane coordinates (candidate Nominatim point was 30 km north) replaced from resolve-pin HIGH; Ian Potter Centre shares its candidate pin with Federation Square (pin-shared): the pins stage must move it 25 m or more from Federation Square (lesser spot: Ian Potter Centre is later in the list).

standalone_near_destinations.why_not_a_spot: Beyond about 75% of the span would still fit at 44 km only by ballooning the span to 90+ km; it is reached from Cranbourne / the Mornington side, not the city.
Langwarrin, reached on its own from Frankston or the Mornington side; adding it would balloon the Melbourne span and the Mornington Peninsula region is the likelier owner.
